newsitem.title: USA: Delta Woodside reaches agreement with banks.
newsitem.headline: Delta Woodside reaches agreement with banks.

text.p: Delta Woodside Industries Inc said Thursday its lending banks have agreed to waive all outstanding defaults under its credit agreement.
The company, which previously had secured the credit facility with accounts receivable, inventory and equipment as collateral, has added its principal buildings and land as collateral, it said.
This latest credit facility matures on September 30, 1997, it said.
Delta Woodside manufactures and sells textile fabrics and apparel. It also is involved in the manufacture and distribution of physical fitness equipment.
